reputation, fame, L.

a multitude of animals, L.
a number of fools, L.
a forest, wood, L.
meeting with, falling in with (gen. or comp.), VarBṛS.; BhP.
a meeting, assembly, congregation, congress, conclave, society, company (cf. द्यूत-स्˚), association, collection (accord. to L. not applied to animals), Āpast.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a convivial meeting, party, club, W.
a quantity, plenty, abundance (in सुख-स्˚), Gīt. xi, 21
